title: An answers page from past requests
summary: A page of questions customers keep asking, with answers taken from your policies.
text: Look at the requests from the last [months] months and find the questions customers ask most. Write an answers page with each question and a short, plain answer taken only from the company's policy files; where no file gives an answer, say so and do not guess. Do not send or publish anything; I will add it to the company files if I agree.
